description: This file defines the 'RandomGenerator' interface in the Apache Commons Math library, specifying methods for various types of pseudo-random number generation, including seed setting, random byte generation, and generating different distributions.

classes.name: RandomGenerator
classes.description: Interface for a random number generator, providing methods for seed management and generating random values of various types.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Sets the seed of the generator using an int, int array, or long value.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills the provided byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns the next pseudorandom integer, or a bounded integer if a parameter is provided.

methods.name: nextLong
methods.description: Returns the next pseudorandom long value.

methods.name: nextFloat
methods.description: Returns a pseudorandom float between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextDouble
methods.description: Returns a pseudorandom double between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a pseudorandom Gaussian-distributed double with mean 0.0 and standard deviation 1.0.
